title: REST APIs
definition: REST uses standard HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) and noun-based URLs (`/users/123`) to interact with resources. It is stateless and highly cacheable.
simpleExplanation: REST is a standard menu at a restaurant. You ask for Item #4, and the kitchen brings you exactly Item #4.

answers.question: What is the main tradeoff of REST APIs?
answers.answer: Usually a tradeoff between Server CPU usage, TTFB (Time to First Byte), and Client CPU usage.
